info.name: Crewdentials — Crew Documents API
info.description:
Add documents to a crew member and read them back, including their verifications.

## Getting started

The `API_KEY` and `WORKFLOW_ID` collection variables are already set for you. `API_KEY` is sent on every request as `Authorization: Bearer <your API key>`, and `WORKFLOW_ID` is the workflow new crew members are created on.

Run **Add documents for a new crew member** first: it saves the new `CREW_PROFILE_ID`, which **Get a crew member’s documents** then reads back.

## Describing documents

Each document is either **described in full** or **left to be read for you**, never a mixture.

- Send none of `name`, `categoryId`, `certificateTypeId`, `documentRef`, `issueDate`, `expiryDate` and the document is scanned, with the details filled in for you.
- Or send all six. Where one does not apply, send it as `null` — a certificate that never expires carries `"expiryDate": null`.

Sending only some of them is rejected with a `400` naming what is missing.

The optional `certificateIssuerId`, `issuerCountry`, `passportNationality` and `data` may accompany a described document.

## Files

Documents carry `imageUrls` (pictures of the document) and `originalFileUrls` (the file as supplied, such as a PDF). At least one of the two is required. Crewdentials downloads them, so they need to be reachable from the public internet while the request runs.

## Your own reference

Give each document a `key`. It is echoed back in the response so you can match the documents Crewdentials created to the ones you sent. It is not stored.

## After importing

Imported documents are not marked complete. Someone in the workspace checks the details over and saves them, at which point `completed` becomes `true` in **Get a crew member’s documents**.

header.description: The API key Crewdentials issued you.

request.description:
Creates a crew member and one profile on `WORKFLOW_ID`, then files the documents against it.

Send `displayName` and leave `crewProfileId` out. The response returns the new `crewId` and `crewProfileId`; keep the profile id to read the documents back, or to send `crewProfileId` instead of `displayName` when adding more documents to the same person later.

Each document below gives nothing but a `key` and its images, so Crewdentials reads them and fills in the details. To supply the details yourself instead, send all six of `name`, `categoryId`, `certificateTypeId`, `documentRef`, `issueDate` and `expiryDate` on that document.

header.description: The API key Crewdentials issued you.
The API key Crewdentials issued you.

request.description:
Every document filed against a crew profile, with its details, files and verifications.

- `completed` is `true` once someone in the workspace has checked the document over and saved it. Documents you have just imported stay `false` until then.
- `imageUrls` and `originalFileUrls` are temporary links, valid for one hour. Download what you need rather than storing the links.
- `verifications` lists the checks carried out on the document. `status` is `VERIFIED_INSTANT` or `VERIFIED_MANUAL` where the document was confirmed, `REJECTED` where it was not. An empty array means the document has not been verified.

response.name: OK
